settings.cloud_api_url_hint: Override the default Hoymiles API endpoint. Leave as default unless you know what you are changing.
settings.dtu_sn_hint: Serial number of your DTU gateway (e.g. 112700000001). Found on the device label. Required for Protobuf protocol.
settings.modbus_unit_id_hint: Modbus slave address. Default: 1. Only change if you have multiple Modbus devices on the same bus.
settings.protobuf_port_hint: TCP port for Hoymiles binary protocol. Default: 10081.
settings.modbus_port_hint: TCP port for Modbus communication. Default: 502.
